KAMIWAZA_TOOL_DISCOVERY_ENABLED.label: Discover ToolShed MCP tools
KAMIWAZA_TOOL_DISCOVERY_ENABLED.description: When enabled, Kamiwaza Flow discovers running Kamiwaza tool extensions and exposes them as MCP tools.

KAMIWAZA_TOOL_DISCOVERY_ENDPOINT_MODE.label: Tool endpoint mode
KAMIWAZA_TOOL_DISCOVERY_ENDPOINT_MODE.description: Choose internal cluster endpoints, external ToolShed routes, or automatic selection.

KAMIWAZA_VERIFY_SSL.label: Verify Kamiwaza SSL
KAMIWAZA_VERIFY_SSL.description: Set false for the local self-signed Kamiwaza certificate.

KAMIWAZA_API_KEY.label: Kamiwaza API key
KAMIWAZA_API_KEY.description: Optional bearer token used for server-side ToolShed MCP discovery.
